patterns.note: Full-screen, color-blocked sections define distinct content areas, with minimal elements presented within each block, creating a highly segmented visual experience.
Primary statements utilize an oversized, bold, uppercase sans-serif font for dramatic impact, contrasted with a smaller, standard-weight sans-serif for supporting details and navigation.
Dramatic shifts in full-screen background colors (light pink, deep maroon, dark teal) are employed to delineate major sections and establish high visual contrast between content blocks.

The initial hero section, featuring repeating text on a light background, scrolls completely out of the viewport to reveal a new, solid-color background. A call-to-action button appears from the bottom and remains sticky.
Sections are primarily differentiated by full-viewport background color changes, creating stark visual breaks and a sense of progression through distinct experiences.

technique_notes: A full-height hero element is designed to scroll entirely off-screen, transitioning the user to the next content block which takes over the full viewport, creating a dramatic reveal effect.
A persistent call-to-action button is introduced after the initial scroll, appearing with a subtle animation and then sticking to a fixed position at the bottom of the screen.
The site uses CSS keyframe animations for elements appearing and disappearing, and for the scroll-driven transitions between full-screen content blocks.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, uppercase display headings (~4-5x body text) with smaller, standard-weight sans-serif for supporting details.
design_tokens.spacing: airy hero and main sections, with balanced density in the footer.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its dramatic, full-screen color-block transitions upon scroll, where entire hero sections disappear to reveal new, contrasting backgrounds. The repeating, oversized text in the initial hero also creates a unique, almost artistic, presentation.
